message.text: The live event mechanism is Server-Sent Events (SSE). The hub is SSEHub. The memo handlers broadcasting through it still need to be identified.
I'll look up the live-event mechanism, the hub implementation, and which memo handlers broadcast through it.

CreateMemo and DeleteMemo in memo_service.go broadcast SSEEventMemoCreated and SSEEventMemoDeleted.

CreateMemoComment in memo_service_comments.go broadcasts SSEEventMemoCommentCreated. UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction in reaction_service.go broadcast SSEEventMemoReactionUpserted and SSEEventMemoReactionDeleted. The SSEEventMemoUpdated broadcast comes from dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects in memo_update_helpers.go, likely triggered by UpdateMemo. The question asks for RPC handler names, not helper functions.

Direct broadcasts are handled by CreateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, and UpsertMemoReaction. These reside in memo_service.go, memo_service_comments.go, and reaction_service.go.

DeleteMemoReaction also broadcasts directly. UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations broadcast indirectly through dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects.

message.text: Checking the function names for SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpdateMemo, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction.

Eight memo handlers broadcast live events: CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, and DeleteMemoReaction.

The mechanism is SSE. The hub is server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go. CreateMemoComment broadcasts its own event because CreateMemo suppresses SSE when invoked internally.

q20.
SSE; server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go; CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction

The hub is `SSEHub` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`, mounted by `RegisterSSERoutes` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`. Those MemoService handlers call `SSEHub.Broadcast` (UpdateMemo, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations go through `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go`).
